title: Quantum numbers in the second shell: neon
caption: n = 2 holds one 2s orbital (l = 0) and three 2p orbitals (l = 1, mₗ = −1, 0, +1). Each orbital holds two electrons of opposite spin, mₛ = +½ (up) and −½ (down): eight electrons in all, 2n².
alt: Orbital boxes for neon: 1s, 2s and three 2p boxes labelled with mₗ = −1, 0 and +1, each holding an up and a down arrow.
description: 1s: one box with a pair of electrons.
2p: three boxes labelled mₗ −1, 0, +1, each with a pair: up for mₛ = +½, down for −½.
